verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a very short path to a working skill. You can create a single SKILL.md, which Claude adds to its toolkit and you invoke with /skill-name, or register the official repo and install skills with two /plugin commands. The plugins guide also covers adding a skill and testing it locally with --plugin-dir. However, no dedicated quickstart with a timed walkthrough is evidenced, and the runtime probe used third-party tooling (npx skills), so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: an explicit step-by-step quickstart page, evidence that the flow completes in under five minutes, and independent hands-on corroboration of the first-party install path.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from nothing to a working installed skill in under five minutes
